label: Prospecting spend
definition: Budget pushed to cold / new audiences.

label: Frequency
definition: Avg impressions per person; too high = fatigue.

label: CPM
definition: Cost per 1,000 impressions; efficiency of reach.

label: % new reach
definition: Share of delivery to never-reached audiences.

label: Creative diversity
definition: Spread of angles & formats in rotation.

label: Landing-page-view rate
definition: Clicks that actually load the page.

label: Landing page views
definition: Sessions that load a landing/entry page.

label: Add-to-cart rate
definition: PDP to ATC; first hard intent.

label: Returning-visitor rate
definition: Share of sessions that are returns.

label: Sessions
definition: Total visits = sum of all sources.
